is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not genotype any of the specified insecticide-resistance markers. It mentions that one strain (LHP) is homozygous for the kdr gene (reference 57), but does not report new genotype data for this or any other marker.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype data (counts or frequencies) for resistance markers are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory-colonized strains (BB, SBE, LHP, MTP, LR) maintained in an insectarium in France, not field-caught mosquitoes.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study on the pathogenicity of a densovirus.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains, not field-collected samples with specific sub-country locations.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study does not report field collection dates for the strains used.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the pathogenicity of the Aedes albopictus densovirus 2 (AalDV2) against five laboratory-colonized strains of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. It does not report any insecticide-resistance marker genotyping.
